about_the_game:
MEET ZOE & CHLOE!

Meet Zoe and Chloe — Echo City's hottest twin assassins. Bold, revealing outfits, clown-inspired makeup, and sexy moves that'll make your knees weak... Their circus act is invite-only. Just don't forget to smile wide, or their very real daggers might fix that for you!

When it comes to sex, Zoe and Chloe live for the thrill: knife play, breath control, hardcore orgies and the wildest experiments you can imagine — if it gets their adrenaline pumping, they're all in. Set these twins as your main screen companions, and you'll never suffer boredom again!


What You Get?

By purchasing this DLC, you'll unlock Zoe and Chloe in their dangerously seductive clown look. You can switch mascots anytime by opening your profile in-game and heading to the "Mascot" tab.

Additionally, you'll receive 5000 credits and 150 super serum.

Most importantly, you'll have our eternal gratitude! Thank you for considering purchasing this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
